payload.name: pc-check-weighted-entries
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that inspects a raw candidate list of weighted entries and returns an explicit validity result without exceptions. The outer input contract admits the raw candidate shape (a list, or a missing/null value) while the inner validation enforces the requested rules. Missing and null are distinct invalid outcomes; the result never raises and never coerces a malformed value into validity. This is a target typed-input interface; the runtime supplies step-local values through the inputs mapping and the kernel enforces global Tool policy before any real dispatch.

composition_summary: Drafted one class-22 PythonCode component pc-check-weighted-entries with name/description/content only. The body is pure logic: it reads the raw candidate with inputs.get("candidate") so missing and null are distinct invalid outcomes rather than a KeyError, returns {ok, entries} on every path without raising, enforces list cardinality 0..3, exact key set {label, weight}, label as a non-bool string of length 1..8, and weight as an exact non-bool integer in 0..1, and never coerces a malformed value into validity. The class-22 content is executable Python with a single module-level result assignment and no imports/host/I/O. The target typed-input interface is documented, not deployed runtime support. No provider capabilities were observed; catalogue_revision and protocol_capabilities are null, so no prompt fix is justified and the volatile tail is echoed unchanged. The draft remains unapproved pending Q1, human Q2 and behavioral validation.
adjusted_volatile_messages: Validate raw weighted entries, including an empty selection.
